# vaelori-designs

Patch rows on this catalog use `"catalog": "vaelori-designs"` and a `key` from the records below. The catalog is closed: a mod changes values with patch rows (see [Patch operations](patch-ops.md)) and cannot add records.

## Records

`guardian`, `avenger`, `raider_off`, `marauder_off`, `intruder_off`, `interdictor_off`, `harbinger_off`, `raider_def`, `marauder_def`, `intruder_def`, `interdictor_def`, `harbinger_def`, `star_fortress`

## Copy this row

A row that changes nothing: `value` and `expect` both hold the base value. Change `value` to the number you want.

```json
{
  "op": "set",
  "catalog": "vaelori-designs",
  "key": "raider_off",
  "path": "cls",
  "value": 0,
  "expect": {"cls":0}
}
```

## Fields

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| `armor` | snake_case key |
| `art` | art key |
| `cls` | integer 0..4 or null |

| `jammer` | list of exactly 5 snake_case keys or null |
| `role` | one of `guardian`, `avenger`, `offense`, `defense`, `fortress` |
| `shield` | snake_case key or null |
| `specials` | list of snake_case keys (no repeats) |
| `weapons` | list of objects |
